title: Figures 109-110: cylinder UAP temperature and Mach number at 1100 mph supersonic CFD
description: Two CFD contour plots for the cylinder UAP at 1/6 scale, 223K and 1100 mph with supersonic inlet and supersonic outlet. Figure 109 shows the temperature field (K) with a broad heated wake; Figure 110 shows the Mach number field with shock structure and a subsonic region trailing the body. BAASS cylinder supersonic case.
